text.p: Following are the main stories in Friday's Malaysian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- ASEAN Foreign Ministers have decided to defer indefinitely the entry of Cambodia into the regional grouping.
-- Acting Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim said Malaysia's stability and strong economic fundamentals should not provide any reason for the ringgit to be undermined.

-- Senator Zainol Abidin Johari was arrested on Thursday by the Anti-Corruption Agency over a criminal breach of trust case involving 20,000 ringgit, said ACA deputy director-general Mohamad Zawawi Mohd Nordin.
-- Malaysian political leaders stepped up their support for the central Bank Negara's crackdown on ringgit speculators.
-- Acting PM Anwar said the country will not tolerate any attempt to undermine the stability of the ringgit.
